beforeImage.name: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs
beforeImage.subsector: Fuel cell and hydrogen equipment financing
beforeImage.description: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs are financing vehicles used to support distributed fuel cell and hydrogen-powered equipment deployments. Their end users include commercial customers adopting hydrogen-powered mobility or power solutions that prefer project-style financing rather than outright equipment purchases. The model is asset-heavy and lease or service contract based, with Generate providing capital against deployed equipment assets. Public materials state that Generate provided Plug with a US$100 million debt facility in 2019 and describe Generate as a capital partner that allowed Plug to pursue deployments without issuing the same amount of corporate equity. The reviewed materials did not disclose individual SPV ownership structures, project-level revenue, or current outstanding asset balances. The 2020 Generate facility amendment increased and repriced an existing relationship, so it was not used to reset Generate's original owner-entry year.

milestones.event: Plug Power announced a US$100 million debt facility from Generate Capital to fund new fuel-cell project deployments.
Plug Power and Generate Capital restructured and increased the existing term loan facility.

afterImage.name: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs
afterImage.subsector: Fuel cell and hydrogen equipment financing
afterImage.description: Plug Power Fuel Cell Asset SPVs is an archived generic financing construct rather than a manager-level operating portfolio company. Plug Power filings document separate sale-leaseback lessors that held title to specified fuel-cell equipment beginning in 2016-2017, followed by a US$100 million secured Generate Lending facility announced in 2019. The Generate loan was debt rather than equity and Plug Power reported repaying it in full in December 2022. Public filings reviewed through August 29, 2026 did not identify an equity conversion, foreclosure, renewed Generate ownership or a current consolidated Generate-owned Plug Power SPV platform. The exact residual disposition of every historical leased-equipment vehicle was not publicly disclosed, but that gap does not support retaining this generic row as an active direct infrastructure holding.
